name: Perdido subsea boosting (Baker Hughes), Gulf of Mexico
description: subsea pumps boosting production from three satellite fields (Great White, Silvertip, Tobago) tied back to the Perdido spar; installed 2010

sources.note: Finding Petroleum, 5 May 2010: Baker Hughes installs subsea pumps at Perdido; Offshore Engineer, 17 Jul 2013 notes the first subsea multiphase pump was installed by Shell at Draugen (read 2026-10-28)
